caseName: Ready Truck Lines, Inc. v. United States
caseNameFull: Ready Truck Lines, Inc. v. United States
attorneys: Messrs. Gerald T. Wiley and /. Austin Latimer for appellant. Assistant Solicitor General Fahy and Mr. Daniel W. Knowlton for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to affirm is granted and the judgment is affirmed. § 209 (a), Part II, Interstate Commerce Act, 49 U. S. C., § 309 (a); United States v. Maher, 307 U. S. 148, 153-4.

Mr. Justice Jackson took no part in the consideration and decision of this case.
